capabilities: Define reusable blocks between share markers in any note
Insert block references with note and block autocomplete
Render references live in Reading view and Live Preview
Pass key=value fill-in values to {{name}} placeholders with defaults
Share a selection as a block and jump to a reference's definition via commands
disambiguation: Not a note-sharing or collaboration tool; 'sharing' means reusing blocks locally within your own vault.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Interface is localized into nine languages. The README documents limitations, such as mid-sentence references not rendering in Live Preview and manual block renames not updating references.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep one block of text defined in a single note and have every place that reuses it update live as you edit.
summary: Reusable text blocks defined once in a note and rendered live in every referencing note, with optional fill-in placeholder values.
